description: Registers one or more suppliers with the guardian, so that their IBAN changes and VIES changes are caught by the nightly checks. The IBANs given enter the ledger as "awaiting confirmation", NEVER as confirmed: an IBAN read on a document is not a baseline. What is left out (plan full, already watched, missing identity) is returned counted and with the reason. Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

suppliers.description: The suppliers to watch. Each needs the Partita IVA (VAT number) or the Codice Fiscale.

expected_country.description: Supplier's EXPECTED country (ISO-2). Defaults to IT if omitted. It is the country a foreign IBAN is judged against: declaring it avoids false alerts on legitimately foreign suppliers.

iban.description: IBAN read on the document. It enters the ledger as "awaiting confirmation".

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

name: guardian_watch_supplier
title: Put suppliers under watch
